familyTheme: Translate Python object-oriented designs to idiomatic Scala 2.13 structures across domains

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Tokenizer OOP Translation Core
derivedTasks.goal: Translate a tokenizer-oriented Python OOP snippet into idiomatic Scala with abstract bases, case classes, inheritance, and companion-object construction helpers.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: This mirrors the source task's class hierarchy translation focus and tests faithful OOP mapping quality.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Job Scheduler Class Hierarchy Translation
derivedTasks.goal: Translate a Python batch scheduler hierarchy into Scala using abstract classes, case classes, and overridden behavior.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers class/inheritance mapping to a scheduling domain while preserving OOP semantics and builder style APIs.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Payment Strategy Trait Mix Translation
derivedTasks.goal: Translate Python payment classes with multiple behavior mixins into Scala traits plus class inheritance and companion factories.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Exercises conversion of Python multiple inheritance idioms into Scala trait composition with strong typing.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Plugin Registry Object Model Translation
derivedTasks.goal: Translate a Python plugin architecture into Scala using traits, case classes, mutable registries, and companion object constructors.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Transfers OOP translation patterns into registry and plugin composition patterns with static/class-method style behavior.
